cohort: The study included 85 healthy term appropriate for gestational age (AGA) newborn babies.
finding: The study demonstrated high median serum BNP levels of 341.43 pg/ml in healthy term Nigerian newborns, with no significant relationship observed between BNP and chronological age, birth weight, gender, or gestational age.
mod_finding: No significant relationship was found between serum BNP levels and mode of delivery.
